candidates.source_name: TED (Tenders Electronic Daily) — notice search, EN interface
candidates.why_relevant: Official EU Supplement to the Official Journal (OJ S). Every above-threshold Slovenian banking/payments contract notice and contract award notice must appear here, CPV-coded and with an English version. Primary EU-level channel for the SI cell; filterable by country=Slovenia and CPV (66100000, 66110000, 66172000, 30144200).
candidates.access_status: open, free, no login for search and notice viewing
candidates.legal_status: EU public sector information; reuse permitted under the Commission reuse decision (2011/833/EU) with attribution
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Prefer the TED Search API over HTML scraping; use expert query on country + CPV + form type, then pull notice XML/PDF per notice ID.
candidates.discovered_via_method: seed query + snowball from search results
queries_used: TED contract award notice Slovenia CPV 66110000 banking services

candidates.source_name: TED — Slovenian-language interface (/sl)
candidates.why_relevant: Same notice corpus rendered in Slovenian, so notice titles/objects appear with the native procurement vocabulary (javno naročilo, obvestilo o oddaji naročila, bančne storitve, plačilni promet, bankomat). Useful for building the SI glossary and for matching TED notices back to national enarocanje.si records.
candidates.legal_status: EU PSI reuse permitted with attribution
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Fetch /sl/notice/{id} alongside /en/notice/{id} to build a bilingual sl-en term pairs table.
queries_used: javno naročilo Slovenija bankomati CPV 30144200 obvestilo o oddaji naročila TED

candidates.source_name: TED Search API (api.ted.europa.eu, v3)
candidates.why_relevant: Machine-readable, anonymous-access query interface over all published TED notices. Supports expert queries (country, CPV, notice type, publication date) and bulk retrieval of notice XML. This is the single highest-leverage collection route for the whole A2 workstream at EU level.
candidates.access_status: open; anonymous access for reading published notices; pagination capped (reported ~15,000 docs per query, 250 per page)
candidates.legal_status: EU PSI reuse permitted; observe documented rate limits
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scheduled daily expert-query pull filtered on place-of-performance/buyer country = SVN and CPV in {66100000*, 66110000*, 66150000, 66172000, 30144200, 72212900 adjacent}; store raw eForms XML plus normalised fields.
candidates.discovered_via_method: targeted search on TED developer documentation
queries_used: TED API v3 search notices eForms documentation developer.ted.europa.eu

candidates.source_name: TED Developer Docs (docs.ted.europa.eu) — API and Open Data Service guides
candidates.why_relevant: Authoritative documentation for query syntax, field names, eForms field IDs, pagination and versioning. Required to write correct CPV/country expert queries and to keep the collector working across TED API versions.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Manual reading at integration time; watch the /ODS/latest/reuse/ pages for changes.
queries_used: TED API v3 search notices eForms documentation developer.ted.europa.eu

candidates.source_name: TED bulk XML packages (daily and monthly editions)
candidates.why_relevant: Full historical corpus of OJ S notices as XML, monthly collections reported back to 2011 and an FTP archive reported back to 1993. Enables a one-off backfill of all Slovenian banking/payments notices rather than incremental-only collection.
candidates.access_status: reported open without sign-in via direct package links (pattern https://ted.europa.eu/packages/notice/monthly/{yyyy-n}); unverified by me
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-time historical backfill: download monthly packages, filter XML on country=SI and target CPVs, then switch to API for incremental.
queries_used: TED bulk download notices data.europa.eu open data monthly packages XML

candidates.source_name: TED Open Data Service
candidates.why_relevant: TED's own open-data front end, exposing notices as structured/linked data for reuse. Alternative to the Search API when RDF/SPARQL-style querying or dataset snapshots are preferable.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Evaluate against the Search API; use for bulk analytical snapshots and CPV distribution analysis.
queries_used: TED bulk download notices data.europa.eu open data monthly packages XML

candidates.source_name: EU Open Data Portal — TED dataset (CSV subset of contract and award notices)
candidates.why_relevant: Pre-flattened CSV extract of the most important TED contract notice / contract award notice fields (buyer, value, winner, CPV, country). Fastest path to a first analytical cut of SI banking/payments contract values and incumbent suppliers without parsing XML.
candidates.legal_status: EU PSI reuse permitted with attribution
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Download yearly CSVs, filter ISO_COUNTRY_CODE=SI and CPV prefix 661/6610/3014, join back to TED notice IDs for full text.
queries_used: TED bulk download notices data.europa.eu open data monthly packages XML

candidates.source_name: TED — Developers' corner for reusers / data reuse pages
candidates.why_relevant: Hub page linking every reuse channel (API, bulk packages, ODS, reusers' workshops, schema changes). Best single pointer to keep the collector aligned with TED's migration from TED-schema to eForms.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Low-frequency monitoring for changes; read linked reusers-workshop decks.
queries_used: TED bulk download notices data.europa.eu open data monthly packages XML

candidates.source_name: SIMAP section on TED — European public procurement rules and thresholds (Slovenian version)
candidates.why_relevant: SIMAP is now folded into TED; the /sl/simap pages explain in Slovenian which contracts must be published EU-wide and at what thresholds. Defines the boundary between what appears on TED versus only on the national portal — essential for scoping coverage and for interpreting gaps.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off read + annual re-check when thresholds are revised.
queries_used: javno naročilo Slovenija bankomati CPV 30144200 obvestilo o oddaji naročila TED

candidates.source_name: CPV — Enotni besednjak javnih naročil (Common Procurement Vocabulary) on TED, Slovenian
candidates.why_relevant: Authoritative CPV code list with Slovenian labels. Gives the exact native wording for each target code (66100000 storitve bančništva in investicijskega bančništva, 66110000 bančne storitve, 66172000 obdelava plačilnih transakcij, 30144200 stroji za izdajanje bankovcev / bankomati), which is what makes the national-portal cross-matching and sl-language searching precise.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Download the CPV codelist (also shipped as Genericode in the eForms SDK) and store sl/en labels as the project glossary spine.
queries_used: SIMAP portal javnih naročil Slovenija CPV 66110000 bančne storitve razpis

candidates.source_name: OP-TED eForms SDK (GitHub)
candidates.why_relevant: Ships the XML schemas (UBL 2.3 pre-award), codelists as Genericode (including CPV and country codes), notice-type JSON definitions and Schematron rules. Needed to parse eForms notice XML reliably and to map field IDs to business meaning (buyer, value, winner, framework agreement, lots).
candidates.legal_status: open-source repository under the OP-TED organisation; check per-repo licence before redistribution
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Pin an SDK version in the parser; track releases for breaking changes.
queries_used: OP-TED eForms SDK github CPV codes XML schema notice viewer

candidates.source_name: OP-TED eForms Notice Viewer (GitHub)
candidates.why_relevant: Reference implementation that renders any eForms notice XML to HTML in a chosen language. Practical way to produce human-readable Slovenian and English renderings of collected SI notices for analyst review without building a renderer.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Optional tooling, not a data source; run locally on stored XML.
queries_used: OP-TED eForms SDK github CPV codes XML schema notice viewer

candidates.source_name: EU Funding & Tenders Portal (SEDIA) — calls for tenders and grants
candidates.why_relevant: Single electronic data interchange area for EU-managed procurement and funding. Relevant to the SI cell for two things: EU-institution procurement that Slovenian banking/payments vendors can bid on, and EU-funded programmes (digitalisation, e-government, payments infrastructure) whose Slovenian beneficiaries later run national tenders — an early-warning layer ahead of TED notices.
candidates.access_status: open for browsing; account required for submission (not needed for monitoring)
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monitor the tender-search and grants screens filtered on keywords (payment, banking, card, ATM) and on Slovenian participants; the portal exposes a JSON search endpoint used by its own UI.
queries_used: EU Funding and Tenders Portal opportunities API SEDIA procurement contract notices

candidates.source_name: EU Funding & Tenders Portal search API (SEDIA JSON endpoint)
candidates.why_relevant: Programmatic route to the F&T Portal's opportunity and project data, widely used by third-party integrators. Would let the collector track EU-funded projects with Slovenian banking/payments relevance systematically rather than by hand.
candidates.legal_status: EU PSI; endpoint is not formally published as a public contract, so treat as best-effort and low-rate
candidates.access_status: reported to require an apiKey query parameter (commonly the public SEDIA key); unverified by me
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Low-frequency polling with conservative rate limits; fall back to HTML/portal export if the endpoint changes.
queries_used: EU Funding and Tenders Portal opportunities API SEDIA procurement contract notices

candidates.source_name: Publications Office — public procurement / procurement-details pages (op.europa.eu)
candidates.why_relevant: Publications Office renders individual EU procurement records with buyer, CPV, award method, estimated and final contract value. A confirmed Slovenian banking-services example was found here (Aerodrom/Brnik, CPV 66110000, awarded to SKB d.d.), demonstrating it as a usable secondary rendering of TED data with clean value fields.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Use as a cross-check/enrichment for specific notice IDs, not as the primary crawl target.
queries_used: TED contract award notice Slovenia CPV 66110000 banking services

candidates.source_name: Portal javnih naročil (enarocanje.si) — national mirror of TED-published SI notices
candidates.why_relevant: Slovenian national portal run by Uradni list RS. Above-threshold notices sent to TED are also published here, usually with the fuller Slovenian tender documentation attached. From this cell's perspective it is the join key: it lets a TED notice ID be resolved to the underlying SI documentation and buyer identity. (Primary ownership belongs to the national-layer cell; recorded here as the cross-link.)
candidates.access_status: open browsing; form pages addressable by id_obrazec
candidates.legal_status: Slovenian public sector information; national reuse rules apply
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Match on TED notice number / buyer name to pull the Slovenian obrazec page and attached documentation.
queries_used: SIMAP portal javnih naročil Slovenija CPV 66110000 bančne storitve razpis

candidates.source_name: e-JN / ejn.gov.si — aktualna javna naročila and guidance
candidates.why_relevant: Slovenia's e-procurement submission system (Ministry of Public Administration). Lists currently open procedures and carries the official guidance pages that define how SI buyers route notices to TED. Useful for confirming that a TED notice corresponds to a live e-JN procedure and for glossary building.
candidates.access_status: open listing; submission requires authenticated account
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic read of the aktualna list; do not attempt authenticated areas.
queries_used: SIMAP portal javnih naročil Slovenija CPV 66110000 bančne storitve razpis

candidates.source_name: OPSI — Odprti podatki Slovenije: Zbirka objavljenih odločitev o oddaji javnega naročila
candidates.why_relevant: Slovenian national open-data dataset of published award decisions. Provides an independent, structured, Slovenian-side check on the TED award-notice set — catching awards that were decided but where the EU-level award notice is late, missing or differently coded.
candidates.legal_status: Slovenian open data licence (typically CC-BY / open); confirm on the dataset page
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scheduled resource download, filter on banking/payments buyers and CPV, reconcile against TED IDs.
queries_used: javno naročilo Slovenija bankomati CPV 30144200 obvestilo o oddaji naročila TED

candidates.source_name: Commercial TED aggregators (TenderWolf, TenderMetric, TenderDetail, TenderRadar)
candidates.why_relevant: Re-publishers of TED data with CPV- and country-scoped landing pages (e.g. a Slovenia EU-tenders page and a CPV 66110000 banking-services page). Valuable mainly as discovery aids and as sanity checks on CPV coverage; not a substitute for the official feed and subject to paywalls.
candidates.access_status: partly open landing pages, core data behind registration/paywall
candidates.legal_status: proprietary presentation of public data; scraping likely against ToS
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Manual reference only; do not scrape. Use for CPV taxonomy sanity checks and to spot notices to look up on TED itself.
queries_used: TED contract award notice Slovenia CPV 66110000 banking services
TED API v3 search notices eForms documentation developer.ted.europa.eu
candidates.observed_blocker: landing pages visible in search results, full notice lists behind sign-up on several of these services

candidates.source_name: Slovenian tender-monitoring aggregators (JavniRazpisi.com, Informator javnih razpisov)
candidates.why_relevant: Slovenian-language commercial monitors that index both national and TED-published notices by branch (e.g. zavarovalniške storitve, varovanje) and explain CPV codes in Slovenian. Useful for glossary building and for finding sector groupings that CPV alone does not express.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Manual reading for terminology; no automated collection.
queries_used: SIMAP portal javnih naročil Slovenija CPV 66110000 bančne storitve razpis
candidates.observed_blocker: subscription-gated alerting; only marketing and blog pages openly indexed

negative_findings.description: No standalone, still-operating SIMAP website exists as a separate source. Searching for SIMAP in both Slovenian and English resolved only to ted.europa.eu/*/simap sections.
negative_findings.result_summary: SIMAP appears to have been absorbed into the TED site; treat it as a set of TED sub-pages (CPV vocabulary, thresholds, XML bulk download, developers' corner), not an independent portal.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents the collector from being built against a legacy simap.ted.europa.eu host that no longer serves data, and clarifies that the SIMAP part of this cell is really TED documentation.

negative_findings.description: Direct Slovenian-language search for ATM-related notices (CPV 30144200, 'bankomati') on TED returned no specific SI notice in the search engine results.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only generic TED/SIMAP pages and unrelated SI notice IDs surfaced; no confirmed Slovenian ATM procurement notice was identified in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: General web search is a poor instrument for CPV-scoped TED retrieval. This does not mean such notices do not exist — it means the CPV-filtered TED Search API, not web search, must be used to establish presence or absence.

negative_findings.description: No TED procurement notices by Banka Slovenije (the Slovenian central bank) for payment-system or banking infrastructure were found via web search.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches returned Banka Slovenije's regulatory and payment-services pages rather than any procurement channel; no dedicated 'javna naročila' procurement page for Banka Slovenije was located in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Banka Slovenije is a plausible high-value buyer for payments infrastructure. Its absence here is unverified, not established — it needs a direct buyer-name query against the TED API and a direct check of bsi.si before any conclusion is drawn.

negative_findings.description: None of the endpoints listed above were fetched or liveness-tested by me; API key requirements, rate limits and exact URL patterns are as reported by documentation and third-party guides.
negative_findings.result_summary: The TED bulk package URL pattern, the reported ~15,000-document API pagination cap, the FTP guest/guest archive, and the SEDIA search-api endpoint all come from documentation or secondary sources rather than my own successful request.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The deterministic verification pass must confirm these before the collector depends on them; a failure at that stage should be read as configuration work, not as a dead source.

coverage_gaps.description: By construction this cell only sees contracts above the EU publication thresholds. Slovenian banking/payments contracts below threshold — likely the majority by count, e.g. single-branch ATM servicing, small card-personalisation or POS lots — never reach TED.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Explicitly delegate below-threshold coverage to the national-layer cell (enarocanje.si, e-JN, OPSI award-decision dataset) and record threshold values per procedure type so the boundary is auditable.

coverage_gaps.description: Commercial banks in Slovenia (NLB, NKBM, SKB, Intesa Sanpaolo Bank, Addiko, Gorenjska banka) and shared infrastructure operators such as Bankart are mostly private entities and are generally not contracting authorities, so their vendor selections do not appear on TED at all. TED captures them mainly as suppliers/winners, not buyers.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Treat TED award notices as an incumbent-supplier map (who wins SI banking/payments contracts) rather than a demand map, and pair it with non-procurement sources for private-bank vendor selection.

coverage_gaps.description: CPV coding is chosen by the buyer and is frequently imprecise: payments-adjacent work is often filed under IT services (72xxxxxx), office/financial machinery (30144200 versus 30123000-family), or generic financial services (66000000), so a strict four-code filter will under-recall.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run the TED query as a union of a broad CPV set (66000000-family, 30144200 and neighbours, 72xxxxxx payments-related) intersected with a bilingual keyword filter (banka, bančne storitve, plačilni promet, plačilne kartice, bankomat, POS, procesiranje transakcij / banking, payment, card, ATM, acquiring, processing), and measure the false-negative rate on a manually labelled sample.

coverage_gaps.description: TED spans two generations of data: legacy TED-schema XML for older notices and eForms (UBL 2.3) for recent ones, with different field structures and value semantics.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build two parsers with a common normalised output, pin an eForms SDK version, and record the schema generation per notice so longitudinal value comparisons stay valid.

coverage_gaps.description: TED's non-Slovenian language versions of SI notices are largely machine-translated summaries; the substantive tender documentation stays in Slovenian on the national portal and is not carried into TED.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Never rely on the English TED rendering for detail. Collect the /sl notice text as the authoritative wording and resolve to enarocanje.si for the underlying documentation.

coverage_gaps.description: EU-funded programme data on the Funding & Tenders Portal (projects with Slovenian banking, fintech or public-payments beneficiaries) was identified but not systematically explored in this pass, and no confirmed Slovenian payments project was located.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated pass over the F&T Portal project and tender screens filtered on Slovenian participants plus payments/banking keywords, to test whether it works as a 6-18 month early-warning layer ahead of national tenders.

brief: The EU-level notice layer for Slovenia is effectively one authoritative source — TED / OJ S — surrounded by a ring of access channels and documentation rather than by competing publishers: the TED web search in both English and Slovenian, the anonymous-access TED Search API, daily and monthly bulk XML packages plus an FTP archive for backfill, a flattened CSV subset on the EU Open Data Portal, and the eForms SDK that makes the XML parseable. SIMAP no longer exists as a separate site; it survives as TED sub-pages carrying the CPV vocabulary with Slovenian labels and the threshold rules that define exactly which Slovenian contracts must appear here at all. The layer is high-credibility, openly licensed and machine-readable, and one confirmed Slovenian banking-services award (CPV 66110000, won by SKB d.d.) was observed, but it is structurally partial: it sees only above-threshold public buyers, so commercial banks and shared processors appear as winners rather than as buyers, and buyer-chosen CPV coding is loose enough that a four-code filter will silently under-recall. The practical build is a CPV-union plus bilingual-keyword query against the TED API, reconciled against enarocanje.si and the OPSI award-decision dataset, with the EU Funding & Tenders Portal monitored separately as a possible early-warning channel.
